experience.title: Piazza San Domenico, Nardò: glasses and evenings for everyone.
experience.text: In the baroque heart of Piazza San Domenico, among Lecce stone and buildings layered with history, L'Angolo diVino welcomes everyone with respect, music and themed evenings, in a setting that makes you want to stay.
